Israeli settlers killed a 72-year-old woman - a mother, a grandmother - this
week. They shot Fadda Mohammed Fheidat in the head. For standing outside her
home. Will anyone be held responsible? Likely not. The Israeli settler charged
with killing Awdah Hathaleen more than a year ago was[
reportedly](https://x.com/infinite_jaz/status/2122704347901608051) seen this
week constructing a new illegal outpost in the occupied West Bank.

In Gaza, Israel launched a broad ground offensive in the central part of the
enclave, forcibly displacing Palestinians who had already been forcibly
displaced time and time again.

The ground offensive escalation "ended," but the horror Palestinians are
forced to endure did not. Israel killed at least seven Palestinians a day
later. Still amid that horror, Palestinians did find a moment of joy in a
swimming competition - a sign of resilience and resistance.
